citations.quote: For every family $(X_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ of nonempty sets indexed by $\mathbb N$ there is a function $f$ with domain $\mathbb N$ such that $f(n)\in X_n$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$.

derivations.claim: Specializing the exact planned conformal scalar-curvature formula to flat eta gives R_g=-6 Omega^-3 Box_eta Omega.
